verses.sloka: स प्रविश्य सभां राजा दीनः परमदुःखितः।निषसादासने सिंहः क्रुद्ध इव श्वसन् ।। ६.९४.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa praviśya sabhāṁ rājā dīnaḥ paramaduḥkhitaḥ।niṣasādāsane siṁhaḥ kruddha iva śvasan ।। 6.94.1 ।।

translations.english: Ravana, the king entered the council, angry like a lion, looking piteous, very sad and sat on the seat.

verses.sloka: अब्रवीच्च स तान् सर्वान् बलमुख्यान् महाबलः।रावणः प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं पुत्रव्यसनकर्शितः ।। ६.९४.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: abravīcca sa tān sarvān balamukhyān mahābalaḥ।rāvaṇaḥ prāñjalirvākyaṁ putravyasanakarśitaḥ ।। 6.94.2 ।।

translations.english: Ravana, endowed with mighty prowess, shrunken on account of his son, greeting all the army chiefs with folded hands spoke as follows.
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण के धनुष के रोदे के टंकार को सुन, इन्द्रजीत के सुखमंडल की रंगत बदल गई और वह लक्ष्मण जी के मुख को । ताकने लगा

verses.sloka: सर्वे भवन्तः सर्वेण हस्त्यश्वेन समावृताः।निर्यान्तु रथसङ्घैश्च पादातैश्चोपशोभिताः ।। ६.९४.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarve bhavantaḥ sarveṇa hastyaśvena samāvṛtāḥ।niryāntu rathasaṅghaiśca pādātaiścopaśobhitāḥ ।। 6.94.3 ।।

translations.english: Let all of you, equipped with every elephant and horse, march forth resplendent with hosts of chariots and foot-soldiers.

verses.sloka: एकं रामं परिक्षिप्य समरे हन्तुमर्हथ।वर्षन्तः शरवर्षेण प्रावृट्काल इवाम्बुदाः ।। ६.९४.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ekaṁ rāmaṁ parikṣipya samare hantumarhatha।varṣantaḥ śaravarṣeṇa prāvṛṭkāla ivāmbudāḥ ।। 6.94.4 ।।

translations.english: Encircling the lone Rama in battle, you ought to slay him, raining showers of arrows like clouds at the time of the monsoon.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! इस समय इन्द्रजीत के मुख की रंगत कां बद- लना आदि जैसे बुरे लक्षण सुमे उसमें देख पड़ रहे हैं, उससे तो हे बलवान ! मुझे जान पड़ता है कि, वह निस्संशय मारा जायगा । अतः इसका आप शीघ्र बघ कीजिये

verses.sloka: अथवा ऽहं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भिन्नगात्रं महारणे।भवद्भिः श्वो निहन्तास्मि रामं लोकस्य पश्यतः ।। ६.९४.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: athavā 'haṁ śaraistīkṣṇairbhinnagātraṁ mahāraṇe।bhavadbhiḥ śvo nihantāsmi rāmaṁ lokasya paśyataḥ ।। 6.94.5 ।।

translations.english: "I shall kill him with huge sharp arrows as the world looks at Rama, once his limbs are struck by you."

verses.sloka: इत्येतद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वाक्यमादाय राक्षसाः।निर्ययुस्ते रथैः शीघ्रैर्नानानीकैः सुसंवृताः ।। ६.९४.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityetadrākṣasendrasya vākyamādāya rākṣasāḥ।niryayuste rathaiḥ śīghrairnānānīkaiḥ susaṁvṛtāḥ ।। 6.94.6 ।।

translations.english: On Rakshasa king speaking like that, all the diverse battalions together departed swiftly on chariots.
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण के छोड़ें हुए बाण, इन्द्रजीत के शारीर में इन्द्र के वज की तरह लगने से, इद्रजीत एक मुहूत्ते तक मूर्छित रहा और उसकी समस्त इन्द्रियाँ बिकल हो गई

verses.sloka: परिघान् पट्टिशांश्चैव शरखड्गपरश्वधान्।शरीरान्तकरान् सर्वे चिक्षिपुर्वानरान् प्रति ।। ६.९४.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: parighān paṭṭiśāṁścaiva śarakhaḍgaparaśvadhān।śarīrāntakarān sarve cikṣipurvānarān prati ।। 6.94.7 ।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas threw at the Vanaras iron bars, clubs, axes, swords, and arrows, which were capable of destroying the life. Vanaras also attacked Rakshasas with trees and rocks.
translations.hindi: एक मुहूर्त बाद ही सचेत ओर सावधान हो उस वीर ने देखा कि, वीरश्रेष्ठ दशरथनन्दन लमण उसके सामने खड़े हैं

verses.sloka: वानराश्च द्रुमान् शैलान् राक्षसान् प्रति चिक्षिपुः ।। ६.९४.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarāśca drumān śailān rākṣasān prati cikṣipuḥ ।। 6.94.8 ।।

translations.english: By the time of sunrise, the most terrific war started between Vanaras and Rakshasas, which became tumultuous.

verses.sloka: स सङ्ग्रामो महान् भीमः सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति।रक्षसां वानराणां च तुमुलः समपद्यत ।। ६.९४.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa saṅgrāmo mahān bhīmaḥ sūryasyodayanaṁ prati।rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca tumulaḥ samapadyata ।। 6.94.9 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras and Rakshasas attacked one another with wonderful maces, darts, swords, and axes in war.

verses.sloka: ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः प्राशैः खड्गैः परश्वधैः।अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुस्तदा वानरराक्षसाः ।। ६.९४.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: te gadābhirvicitrābhiḥ prāśaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ।anyonyaṁ samare jaghnustadā vānararākṣasāḥ ।। 6.94.10 ।।

translations.english: As the war was in progress, wonderful dust had risen which subsided by the flow of blood of Vanaras and Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: पहिली ही बार मैंने वज्रतुल्य बाणों से उस महासमर सें तुम दोनों भाइयों को ब तुम्हारी सेना को ऐसा मारा था कि तुम सब के सब मूछित हो भूमि पर गिर पड़े थे

verses.sloka: एवं प्रवृत्ते सङ्ग्रामे ह्युद्भूतं सुमहद्रजः।रक्षसां वानराणां च शान्तं शोणितविस्रवैः ।। ६.९४.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ pravṛtte saṅgrāme hyudbhūtaṁ sumahadrajaḥ।rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca śāntaṁ śoṇitavisravaiḥ ।। 6.94.11 ।।

translations.english: There with rivers of blood flowing, elephants and chariots were like banks, horses were like fish, staff of chariots like trees and dead bodies as logs of wood seemed.
translations.hindi: जान पड़ता है इसे तू भूल गया । ( क्यों न भूलेगा ) क्योंकि तू तो निश्चय ही यमराज का सहमान होने वाला हे) तभी तो कु श रुरुको अब इतना साहस हो गया है कि, ) सुफको परास्त करना चाहता है

verses.sloka: मातङ्गरथकूलाश्च वाजिमत्स्या ध्वजद्रुमाः।शरीरसङ्घाटवहाः प्रसस्रुः शोणितापगाः ।। ६.९४.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: mātaṅgarathakūlāśca vājimatsyā dhvajadrumāḥ।śarīrasaṅghāṭavahāḥ prasasruḥ śoṇitāpagāḥ ।। 6.94.12 ।।

translations.english: Leaping and jumping the Vanaras and also the leaders of Vanaras bathed in blood broke all kinds of weapons, staff of chariots and the horses.
translations.hindi: अगर तूने प्रथमवार के युद्ध में मेरा पराक्रम नहीं देखा, तो खड़ा रह, अब में तुरे अपना पराक्रम दिखलाए देता हूँ

verses.sloka: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे शोणितौघपरिप्लुताः।ध्वजवर्मरथानश्वान्नानाप्रहरणानि च।आप्लुत्याप्लुत्य समरे राक्षसानां बभञ्जिरे ।। ६.९४.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataste vānarāḥ sarve śoṇitaughapariplutāḥ।dhvajavarmarathānaśvānnānāpraharaṇāni ca।āplutyāplutya samare rākṣasānāṁ babhañjire ।। 6.94.13 ।।

translations.english: Leaping and jumping the Vanaras and also the leaders of Vanaras bathed in blood broke all kinds of weapons, staff of chariots and the horses.

verses.sloka: केशान् कर्णललाटांश्च नासिकाश्च प्लवङ्गमाः।रक्षसां दशनैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नखैश्चापि न्यकर्तयन् ।। ६.९४.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: keśān karṇalalāṭāṁśca nāsikāśca plavaṅgamāḥ।rakṣasāṁ daśanaistīkṣṇairnakhaiścāpi nyakartayan ।। 6.94.14 ।।

translations.english: The monkeys with their sharp teeth and nails tore off the hair, ears, noses, and forehead of the Rakshasas,

verses.sloka: एकैकं राक्षसं सङ्ख्ये शतं वानरपुङ्गवाः।अभ्यधावन्त फलिनं वृक्षं शकुनयो यथा ।। ६.९४.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ekaikaṁ rākṣasaṁ saṅkhye śataṁ vānarapuṅgavāḥ।abhyadhāvanta phalinaṁ vṛkṣaṁ śakunayo yathā ।। 6.94.15 ।।

translations.english: Just as trees laden with fruits are attacked by birds, each one of the Rakshasas was attacked by hundreds of Vanaras.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रजीत की इस वीरता को देर और इसकी कुछ भी चिन्ता न कर, हेसते हुए लक्ष्मण जा ने इन्द्रजीत से कहा--“यह तो कुछ भी नहीं हे । ”

verses.sloka: तथा गदाभिर्गुर्वीभिः प्रासैः खड्गैः परश्वधैः।निजघ्नुर्वानरान् घोरान् राक्षसाः पर्वतोपमाः ।। ६.९४.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathā gadābhirgurvībhiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ।nijaghnurvānarān ghorān rākṣasāḥ parvatopamāḥ ।। 6.94.16 ।।

translations.english: Then the mountainlike forms of Rakshasas attacked the Vanaras with heavy maces, darts, swords, and axes in frightening ways.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर लक्ष्मण जी ने क्रोध में भर और सिभेय हो, बड़े बड़े भयानक बाण निकाल कर, उस युद्ध में इन्द्रजीत के ऊपर छोड़े

verses.sloka: राक्षसैर्युद्ध्यामानानां वानराणां महाचमूः।शरण्यं शरणं याता रामं दशरथात्मजम् ।। ६.९४.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasairyuddhyāmānānāṁ vānarāṇāṁ mahācamūḥ।śaraṇyaṁ śaraṇaṁ yātā rāmaṁ daśarathātmajam ।। 6.94.17 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras being struck by Rakshasas sought the protection of Rama, the son of Dasharatha.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर उन्हेंने कहा-अरे राक्षस समरभूमि में जा कर जो शूर होते हैं, वे इस प्रकार का प्रहार नहीं करते! तेरे बाण तो हल्के, अल्पशक्ति वाले हैं। मुझे तो तेरे इन बाणों से कुछ भी पोड़ा नहीं जान पड़ी, बल्कि इनका प्रहार तो सहज में सहा जा सकता है

verses.sloka: ततो रामो महातेजा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्।प्रविश्य राक्षसं सैन्यं शरवर्षं ववर्ष ह ।। ६.९४.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā dhanurādāya vīryavān।praviśya rākṣasaṁ sainyaṁ śaravarṣaṁ vavarṣa ha ।। 6.94.18 ।।

translations.english: Then, the highly energetic and valiant Rama, taking up the bow showered rain of arrows on Rakshasa army.

verses.sloka: प्रविष्टं तु तदा रामं मेघाः सूर्यमिवाम्बरे।नाभिजग्मुर्महाघोरं निर्दहन्तं शराग्निना ।। ६.९४.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭaṁ tu tadā rāmaṁ meghāḥ sūryamivāmbare।nābhijagmurmahāghoraṁ nirdahantaṁ śarāgninā ।। 6.94.19 ।।

translations.english: Then Rama entered the army with fire like arrows which were consuming the Rakshasas like the clouds in the sky which can't approach the scorching Sun.

verses.sloka: कृतान्येव सुघोराणि रामेण रजनीचराः।रणे रामस्य ददृशुः कर्माण्यसुकराणि च ।। ६.९४.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtānyeva sughorāṇi rāmeṇa rajanīcarāḥ।raṇe rāmasya dadṛśuḥ karmāṇyasukarāṇi ca ।। 6.94.20 ।।

translations.english: The night rangers were able to see Rama's terrible action which was difficult for others only after he had performed not otherwise (as they could not see his quick movement).
translations.hindi: इन्द्रजीत का कवच नष्ट हो जाने पर, बाणा के आघात से उसका सारा शरीर घायल हो, ऐसा देख पड़ा, मानों प्रात:कालीन सूयं हो

verses.sloka: चालयन्तं महानीकं विधमन्तं महारथान्।ददृशुस्ते न वै रामं वातं वनगतं यथा ।। ६.९४.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: cālayantaṁ mahānīkaṁ vidhamantaṁ mahārathān।dadṛśuste na vai rāmaṁ vātaṁ vanagataṁ yathā ।। 6.94.21 ।।

translations.english: They could not see Rama while he was moving and breaking huge chariots as one would not be able to see the trees in the forest when the wind blew fast.

verses.sloka: छिन्नं भिन्नं शरैर्दग्धं प्रभग्नं शस्त्रपीडितम्।बलं रामेण ददृशुर्न रामं शीघ्रकारिणम् ।। ६.९४.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: chinnaṁ bhinnaṁ śarairdagdhaṁ prabhagnaṁ śastrapīḍitam।balaṁ rāmeṇa dadṛśurna rāmaṁ śīghrakāriṇam ।। 6.94.22 ।।

translations.english: They saw the army shattered, broken into pieces, tormented with darts by Rama but could not make out Rama who was very fast in action.
translations.hindi: इससे लक्ष्मण जी का भी कवच टूट गया। इस प्रकार वे दोनों एक दूसरे की मार का बदला लेते देते हुए

verses.sloka: प्रहरन्तं शरीरेषु न ते पश्यन्ति राघवम्।इन्द्रियार्थेषु तिष्ठन्तं भूतात्मानमिव प्रजाः ।। ६.९४.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: praharantaṁ śarīreṣu na te paśyanti rāghavam।indriyārtheṣu tiṣṭhantaṁ bhūtātmānamiva prajāḥ ।। 6.94.23 ।।

translations.english: Just as created beings experience their senses and do not perceive their soul, the army experienced the hitting of Raghava by their senses but were not able to perceive him who was hitting them.
translations.hindi: और बार बार हाफते हुए दोनों वीर तुमुल युद्ध कर रहे थे | दोनों के शरीरों में बाणों के घाव हो गए थे और दोंनों ही रक्त से नहा गये

verses.sloka: एष हन्ति गजानीकमेष हन्ति महारथान्।एष हन्ति शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः पदातीन् वाजिभिः सह ।। ६.९४.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa hanti gajānīkameṣa hanti mahārathān।eṣa hanti śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ padātīn vājibhiḥ saha ।। 6.94.24 ।।

translations.english: 'Rama is here killing elephants', 'Here is Rama destroying chariot warriors', 'Rama is killing horses, foot soldiers with sharp arrows', saying like that, the Rakshasas were striking one another in the battle. Being there where Rama was, they were mistaking one another for Rama there because of the socalled resemblance and attacking one another.
translations.hindi: बहुत देर तक ये दोनों बलवान रणविद्या में निपुण वीर एक दूसरे के उपर पेने ऐने बाण छोड़ एक दूसरे को घायल करते रहे

verses.sloka: इति ते राक्षसाः सर्वे रामस्य सदृशान् रणे।अन्योन्यं कुपिता जघ्नुः सादृश्याद्राघवस्य ते ।। ६.९४.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti te rākṣasāḥ sarve rāmasya sadṛśān raṇe।anyonyaṁ kupitā jaghnuḥ sādṛśyādrāghavasya te ।। 6.94.25 ।।

translations.english: 'Rama is here killing elephants', 'Here is Rama destroying chariot warriors', 'Rama is killing horses, foot soldiers with sharp arrows', saying like that, the Rakshasas were striking one another in the battle. Being there where Rama was, they were mistaking one another for Rama there because of the socalled resemblance and attacking one another.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे दोनों ही जयाभिलाषी ओर भयानक पराक्रमी थे। वे एक दूसरे के बाणों से घायल हो गए थे । उनके शरीरों के कवच ओर उनकी ४३जाएँ नष्ट हो चुकी थीं

verses.sloka: न ते ददृशिरे रामं दहन्तमरिवाहिनीम्।मोहिताः परमास्त्रेण गान्धर्वेण महात्मना ।। ६.९४.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: na te dadṛśire rāmaṁ dahantamarivāhinīm।mohitāḥ paramāstreṇa gāndharveṇa mahātmanā ।। 6.94.26 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas got confused by the supreme missile presided over by Gandharvas, released by Rama, which was burning their army, and were not able to see.
translations.hindi: उनके घावों से गमे गम लोहू बैसे ही बह रहा था जैसे झरने से जल । वे भयंकर सिंहनाद करते हुए भयंकर शरवषों कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: ते तु रामसहस्राणि रणे पश्यन्ति राक्षसाः।पुनः पश्यन्ति काकुत्स्थमेकमेव महाहवे ।। ६.९४.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tu rāmasahasrāṇi raṇe paśyanti rākṣasāḥ।punaḥ paśyanti kākutsthamekameva mahāhave ।। 6.94.27 ।।

translations.english: In the battle those Rakshasas could see a thousand Ramas at one place and again one Rama alone at another place
translations.hindi: आकाश में बर्षा करते हुए नीले रंग के काले दो बादलों की तरह, एक दूसरे पर बाणों की वृष्टि करते हुए और लड़ते लड़ते, उन दोनों वीरों का बहुत सा समय व्यतोत हो गया

verses.sloka: भ्रमन्तीं काञ्चनीं कोटिं कार्मुकस्य महात्मनः।अलातचक्रप्रतिमां ददृशुस्ते न राघवम् ।। ६.९४.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhramantīṁ kāñcanīṁ koṭiṁ kārmukasya mahātmanaḥ।alātacakrapratimāṁ dadṛśuste na rāghavam ।। 6.94.28 ।।

translations.english: While Rama was going around in circles with his bow, the Rakshasas were confused, and saw the golden ends of the bow to be like a burning fire stick circling and could not see Rama.
translations.hindi: तो भी न तो किसी ने पीठ दिखाई ओर न कोई थका । अल्ञ- विद्या जानने वालों में श्रेष्ठ दोनों हीं बोर बारंबार अपने अपने शरों की उत्कृष्टता दिखला रहे थे

verses.sloka: शरीरनाभिसत्त्वार्चिः शरीरं नेमिकार्मुकम्।ज्याघोषतलनिर्घोषं तेजोबुद्धिगुणप्रभम् ।। ६.९४.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: śarīranābhisattvārciḥ śarīraṁ nemikārmukam।jyāghoṣatalanirghoṣaṁ tejobuddhiguṇaprabham ।। 6.94.29 ।।

translations.english: People saw Rama in the form of wheel exterminating the Rakshasas on the battlefield, which had the body of Sri Rama as its navel, his strength as its glow, the arrows as spokes, his bow as belly, the twangling of the bowstring as its sound, his virtues and effulgence as the power of his mystic missiles in war. Rama was seen as a wheel of time spirit by the people.

verses.sloka: दिव्यास्त्रगुणपर्यन्तं निघ्नन्तं युधि राक्षसान्।ददृशू रामचक्रं तत् कालचक्रमिव प्रजाः ।। ६.९४.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: divyāstraguṇaparyantaṁ nighnantaṁ yudhi rākṣasān।dadṛśū rāmacakraṁ tat kālacakramiva prajāḥ ।। 6.94.30 ।।

translations.english: People saw Rama in the form of wheel exterminating the Rakshasas on the battlefield, which had the body of Sri Rama as its navel, his strength as its glow, the arrows as spokes, his bow as belly, the twangling of the bowstring as its sound, his virtues and effulgence as the power of his mystic missiles in war. Rama was seen as a wheel of time spirit by the people.
translations.hindi: दोनों, लक्ष्मण आर इन्द्रजीत तुमुल युद्ध कर रहे थे। दोनों के भयंकर सिंहनाद का शब्द प्रथक्‌ प्रथक्‌ सुन फ्ड़ता था

verses.sloka: अनीकं दशसाहस्रं रथानां वातरंहसाम्।अष्टादश सहस्राणि कुञ्जराणां तरस्विनाम् ।। ६.९४.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: anīkaṁ daśasāhasraṁ rathānāṁ vātaraṁhasām।aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi kuñjarāṇāṁ tarasvinām ।। 6.94.31 ।।

translations.english: In the eighth part of the day, in the battlefield, an army of Rakshasas who were capable of changing their forms at will, constituting a myriad of chariots with wind speed, eighteen thousand fleetfooted elephants, fourteen thousand horses with riders, two lakh Rakshasas fighting on foot exterminated by Rama singlehanded with his arrows that resembled tongues of fire.
translations.hindi: बज्रपात की तरह उस घोर दारुण सिंहनाद कोसुन, सुनने वालों के हृदय कॉप उठे | उत्त रणोन्मप्त दोनों चीखें के गर्जन का शब्द, ऐसा जान पड़ता था, मानों आकाश में बढ़े ज़ोर से बादलों की भयंकर गड़गड़ाहट हो रही हो । सुवर्ण पुख वाले नाराचों से दोनों बलवानों के शरीर घायल हो जाने पर,

verses.sloka: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि सारोहाणां च वाजिनाम्।पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे राक्षसानां पदातिनाम् ।। ६.९४.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi sārohāṇāṁ ca vājinām।pūrṇe śatasahasre dve rākṣasānāṁ padātinām ।। 6.94.32 ।।

translations.english: In the eighth part of the day, in the battlefield, an army of Rakshasas who were capable of changing their forms at will, constituting a myriad of chariots with wind speed, eighteen thousand fleetfooted elephants, fourteen thousand horses with riders, two lakh Rakshasas fighting on foot exterminated by Rama singlehanded with his arrows that resembled tongues of fire.

verses.sloka: दिवसस्याष्टमे भागे शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः।हतान्येकेन रामेण रक्षसां कामरूपिणाम् ।। ६.९४.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: divasasyāṣṭame bhāge śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ।hatānyekena rāmeṇa rakṣasāṁ kāmarūpiṇām ।। 6.94.33 ।।

translations.english: In the eighth part of the day, in the battlefield, an army of Rakshasas who were capable of changing their forms at will, constituting a myriad of chariots with wind speed, eighteen thousand fleetfooted elephants, fourteen thousand horses with riders, two lakh Rakshasas fighting on foot exterminated by Rama singlehanded with his arrows that resembled tongues of fire.
translations.hindi: विजय. और दीर्ति पाने के लिए यत्न करते हुए उन दोनों बलशालियों के घावों से रुधिर की धाराएँ बह रही थीं। ६६६ युद्धकाण्डे उस समय सुवणं पुंख वाले बाण उत दोनों के शरीर का भेदन कर

verses.sloka: ते हताश्वा हतरथाः शान्ता विमथितध्वजाः।अभिपेतुः पुरीं लङ्कां हतशेषा निशाचराः ।। ६.९४.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: te hatāśvā hatarathāḥ śāntā vimathitadhvajāḥ।abhipetuḥ purīṁ laṅkāṁ hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ ।। 6.94.34 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasas dead, chariots destroyed, staff of chariots broken, remaining Rakshasas returned to Lanka.
translations.hindi: रुधिर से तर हो, धरतो में घुस जाते थे। दोनों बोरों के छोड़े हुए बहुत पेने पेने शस्र आकाश में एक दूसरे से टक्क खा कर

verses.sloka: हतैर्गजपदात्यश्वैस्तद्बभूव रणाजिरम्।आक्रीडमिव रुद्रस्य क्रुद्धस्य सुमहात्मनः ।। ६.९४.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: hatairgajapadātyaśvaistadbabhūva raṇājiram।ākrīḍamiva rudrasya kruddhasya sumahātmanaḥ ।। 6.94.35 ।।

translations.english: With the elephants, horses, and foot soldiers killed, the battlefield was like the ground where mighty Rudra sported in anger.

verses.sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः।साधु साध्विति रामस्य तत् कर्म समपूजयन् ।। ६.९४.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ।sādhu sādhviti rāmasya tat karma samapūjayan ।। 6.94.36 ।।

translations.english: Then, the Gandharvas, Devas, and Siddhas were very happy and praised Sri Rama saying, 'well done, well done' and offered prayers.
translations.hindi: परस्पर प्रहार कर रहे थे, किन्तु दो में से एक भो थकता नः था । अंगोंमें गड़े हुए बाणों से छन दोनों बलवान्‌ वीरों की ऐसी शोभा हो रही थी, जैसी वृक्षों से यक्त दो पवतों की शोभा होती है । वे दोनों रक्त से नहाए हुए थे ओर बाणां से उनके शरीर ढके हुए थे

verses.sloka: अब्रवीच्च तदा रामः सुग्रीवं प्रत्यनन्तरम्।विभीषणं च धर्मात्मा हनूमन्तं च वानरम् ।। ६.९४.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: abravīcca tadā rāmaḥ sugrīvaṁ pratyanantaram।vibhīṣaṇaṁ ca dharmātmā hanūmantaṁ ca vānaram ।। 6.94.37 ।।

translations.english: Then righteous Sri Rama said to nearby Sugriva, Vibheeshana, Hanuman, Jambavan and leaders of Vanaras like Mainda, Dwivida, that the power of these arrows are in him and Lord Siva only.

verses.sloka: जाम्बवन्तं हरिश्रेष्ठं मैन्दं द्विविदमेव च।एतदस्त्रबलं दिव्यं मम वा त्र्यम्बकस्य वा ।। ६.९४.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavantaṁ hariśreṣṭhaṁ maindaṁ dvividameva ca।etadastrabalaṁ divyaṁ mama vā tryambakasya vā ।। 6.94.38 ।।

translations.english: Then righteous Sri Rama said to nearby Sugriva, Vibheeshana, Hanuman, Jambavan and leaders of Vanaras like Mainda, Dwivida, that the power of these arrows are in him and Lord Siva only.

verses.sloka: निहत्य तां राक्षसवाहिनीं तु रामस्तदा शक्रसमो महात्मा।अस्त्रेषु शस्त्रेषु जितक्लमश्च संस्तूयते देवगणैः प्रहृष्टैः ।। ६.९४.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: nihatya tāṁ rākṣasavāhinīṁ tu rāmastadā śakrasamo mahātmā।astreṣu śastreṣu jitaklamaśca saṁstūyate devagaṇaiḥ prahṛṣṭaiḥ ।। 6.94.39 ।।

translations.english: Having thus destroyed that army of rakshasas, the great-souled Rama, the equal of Indra, unwearied in the use of missiles and weapons, was praised by the rejoicing hosts of gods.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुर्नवतितमः सर्गः ।। ९४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe caturnavatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 94 ।।
